## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Link the
issue, or describe why this focused change is needed. Do not include secrets.

## Scope and compatibility

- Affected runtime(s), modules and public APIs:
- Protocol/default/authorization/upload/IPC impact (or explain no impact):
- Node–Go comparison or why only one runtime is affected:
- Migration/known limitations:

## Validation

List exact commands and observed results; distinguish skipped/unavailable checks.
For a bug, show failing baseline and passing regression. For docs, include strict
MkDocs/link/example checks and actual diagram rendering as applicable.

- [ ] Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/CellsWeb/crpc-node/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Change is focused; unrelated files, credentials and generated artifacts excluded.
- [ ] Relevant tests/docs are updated; no validation/auth/cleanup checks weakened.
- [ ] API/protocol/default changes were discussed before implementation.
- [ ] Runtime/OS/toolchain and remaining limitations are recorded.

Security-sensitive findings belong in the private reporting channel, not this PR.
